reports.text: [ESET WeLiveSecurity](https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/exchange-for-breakfast-turlas-cereal-tricks-are-not-for-kids/) reported on the Turla group's Cereal toolset, which features an Exchange email collection module, a command and control mechanism, and.NET execution techniques.

[Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/10/eset-turla-exchange-malware/) reported that the Russia-aligned group Turla planted a modular.NET toolset on Microsoft Exchange servers at two government organizations, one in Kazakhstan and one in Romania.

[The Record](https://therecord.media/russia-hackers-espionage-romania-kazakhstan) reported that Russian state-linked hackers compromised government email servers in Romania and Kazakhstan to secretly intercept messages exchanged with NATO and European officials.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/russian-turla-hackers-use-new-cereal.html) reported that the Russia-aligned state-sponsored threat actor known as Turla is wielding a previously undocumented cyber espionage toolset called Cereal to steal emails from government Exchange servers.

[CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/russian-turla-group-used-new-toolset-to-silently-pilfer-emails-from-kazakhstan-romanian-governments/) reported that ESET published research on Turla's Cereal tools targeting Microsoft Exchange servers in the Kazakhstan and Romanian governments without obvious indicators of compromise.

narratives.label: US cryptocurrency and infrastructure seizure

reports.text: [Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/us-freezes-2-7-billion/) reported that the US government froze more than $2.7 billion of crypto stolen from Binance on or about October 29, 2026, and the FBI stated North Korea took over $6 billion.

[CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/us-seizes-north-korea-hacking-infrastructure-binance/) reported that the US seized North Korean hacking infrastructure belonging to APT38 containing footage used to fool victims over video calls, alongside cryptocurrency stolen from Binance.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/fbi-says-us-seized-1-2-billion-worth-of-cryptocurrency-stolen-from-binance/) reported that the FBI stated the US seized 1.2 billion dollars worth of cryptocurrency stolen from Binance and blamed North Korea for a separate social engineering scheme.

articles.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
Unpatched Check Point Gateways Are Being Wiped exploiting PHP2Shell
Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Check Point Gateways to Deploy TSGA Backdoor and Wipe ESXi Files
PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks
Hackers Exploit Check Point Firewall Flaws to Gain Root Access and Deploy Wiper Malware on VMware ESXi
PHP2Shell Exploitation on Check Point Gateway

narratives.label: Check Point firewall exploitation
previous_titles: Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Check Point Gateways to Deploy TSGA Backdoor and Wipe ESXi Files
Unpatched Check Point Gateways Are Being Wiped exploiting PHP2Shell

reports.text: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/check-point-gateways-hacked-via-php2shell-to-deploy-vmware-esxi-wiper/) reported that vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/check-point-patches-zero-day-that-lets-hackers-get-root-access/) reported that Check Point Software released emergency hotfixes for a high-severity zero-day flaw exploited for root access and persistence.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/php2shell-exploited-in-destructive-check-point-gateway-attacks/) reported that PHP2Shell enabled initial compromise while CVE-2026-123039 allowed attackers to elevate privileges to root on Check Point Gateway.

[Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202982/hacking/unpatched-check-point-gateways-are-being-wiped-exploiting-php2shell.html) reported that unpatched Check Point gateways were hacked worldwide, leading to root access, backdoors, network intrusion, and destructive wiper attacks starting on 30 October.

[Check Point Research](https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/php2shell-exploitation-on-check-point-gateway/) reported that activity originating from PHP2Shell exploitation on Check Point Gateway was confirmed in late October 2026, approximately one week after a security fix became available.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/hackers-exploit-check-point-firewall-flaws/) reported that hackers chained Check Point firewall vulnerabilities to gain root access, plant backdoors, and deploy destructive malware on a VMware ESXi host.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-php2shell-flaws-in.html) reported that an unknown threat actor targeted unpatched Check Point Security Gateways to obtain initial access via PHP2Shell vulnerabilities and deploy the TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files.

narratives.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
